resources.string: Picks the closest Roblox server for you when you join a game from Voidstrap.
Smart Join needs your Roblox login. Open Settings, Voidstrap Matchmaker to sign in.

Signed in to Roblox inside Voidstrap
Not signed in. Sign in to Roblox here to use Smart Join.
Voidstrap only sends your login to Roblox, to ask which datacenter each server runs in. It is never saved by Voidstrap.
How Voidstrap chooses between the servers it finds
Voidstrap will always try this one first and only fall back when it has no room
No datacenters learned yet, they appear as you play.
Turn one off to never be placed there. If Roblox puts you in a blocked datacenter, Voidstrap moves you out.
